name: Zoo Teens events
what_you_do: Free events just for teens, led by zoo experts. You can make conservation art, learn to live next to city wildlife like bats and birds, and play a role-playing game.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 18 from across the Chicago area. Parents are not allowed at the events.
duration: Single events on select days through the year
deadline_text: Events listed for Saturday Oct 31 (Roll for Wildlife, Prism Games, Logan Square) and Saturday Nov 7 (Plants and Prints, Lincoln Park Zoo). The page does not state the year. Register on the page.
how_to_apply: Register for each event with the Register Now button on the Zoo Teens page.
notes: Going to an event adds you to the list for news about the zoo's internships and other teen programs. Parking is at 2400 N. Cannon Drive for events at the zoo.
